title: Bangladesh’s economy grows faster in Apr: PMI data
content:
Economic activities in Bangladesh grew at a faster pace in April, backed primarily by stronger performance in agriculture and a manufacturing rebound. 
The latest PMI rose by 1.1 points month on month to 54.6. 
The manufacturing sector returned to expansion after contracting in the previous month, supported by stronger growth in factory output, input purchases and input prices.

title: Vietnam’s textile & garment exports inch up to $11.9 bn in Jan-April
content:
Vietnam’s textile and garment exports rose modestly by 1.3 per cent YoY to $11.93 billion in January-April 2026, while yarn exports also posted gains in value and volume.
Fabric imports remained largely stable despite softer annual demand, though April recorded a sharp monthly rebound.
VITAS has set an ambitious $50 billion export target for 2026 amid steady production-linked import demand.

title: BGMEA-IVY Decarb MoU to push decarbonisation in Bangladesh RMG sector
content:
BGMEA and Spain-headquartered IVY Decarb Marketplace SL have signed an MoU to strengthen collaboration on industrial decarbonisation, productivity improvement and sustainable machinery transition in Bangladesh’s textile and garment sector. 
Both sides will work to introduce decarbonisation methodologies to BGMEA members, and support the sector in exploring advanced, energy-efficient industrial machinery.
